name: ldap-signing-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): relaxes the domain controller's LDAP server signing requirement to None by setting HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters\LDAPServerIntegrity to 1. Vars: none (parameterless). With signing not required, NTLM-authenticated LDAP traffic can be read/relay tampered in transit; the hardened state is 2 (Require Signing). Must run on a DC (the NTDS key only exists there). Pairs with registry_value or powershell_json checks reading NTDS\Parameters\LDAPServerIntegrity and expecting 2 after hardening.
